rank_contract: Pure, deterministic; returns complete copied rows, no I/O/filter/authorization/budget/truncation. Missing id invalid. Exact ID/title anchor first, token relevance, diversity among equal relevance, admitted centrality/recency only ties. No proof/truth claims.
integration: nos_packet.build retains source allowlist and reread. Parent packs whole blocks, never block[:remaining]. Required protection groups are handled by retrieve, not rank_nodes alone.
scope: Reuse ALLOWED_TYPES/SCIENCE_ROOTS/DENIED from nos_packet as pinned static policy; no runtime import of provider stack. Further exact deployment catalog controls nodes/paths and obligation closures. User cannot choose paths/catalog.
